name: Multi-Language SCORM Wrapper
tagline: Puts several language versions of one e-learning module into a single SCORM 1.2 package, with a language choice screen.
summary: An open-source package, kept under its MIT licence, for SCORM 1.2, a standard file format for e-learning courses. Learners pick a language, and the module opens in that language. The learning platform sees one course, however many languages are inside.
features: Offer one course in several languages without a separate course for each.
Set the course title, the language screen wording and the default language.
Remember the learner's choice, so they return to the same language next time.
no_demo: A SCORM package needs an LMS to run it. The pictures show it.

gallery.caption: When a learner opens the course, one screen lists all the languages in the package.
gallery.alt: The language screen of a sample course, with 12 languages in a list and English selected

gallery.caption: The screen confirms the language that the learner selects. Launch Course then opens that language version.
gallery.alt: The same screen with French selected, a confirmation message and the Launch Course button

gallery.caption: As supplied, the package has six sample languages, a sample title and a placeholder logo for you to replace.
gallery.alt: The language screen with its supplied settings: six languages, a sample title and a logo placeholder

guides.title: Choose the language of a course

steps.text: If your language is not selected, select it in the list of languages.
Make sure that the message shows your language.
Select **Launch Course**. The course opens in your language.
